title: Read-only change projection v0.9
summary: TimeChangePublication.project converts validated single.time.impact/0.1 comparison data into at most 366 single.time.change/0.1 advisory records. Length-prefixed compound idempotency keys are stable tuple encodings, not signatures. Output carries authority revision/witness pairs and explicit rule snapshot identifiers on cross-provider comparisons.
invariants: No queue write, RPC call, acknowledgement, implicit clock read or calendar mutation.
For cross-provider rule comparisons require immutable from/to snapshot identifiers.
Nested before/after records are not guaranteed deep immutable; transport must freeze and validate serialized payload.

provenance.claim: Verified against locally inspected v0.9 package source.
